name: Gakin's Summons
summary: From Ironforge, Gakin's Summons sends promising Alliance warlocks south to Stormwind. Beneath the Mage Quarter, Gakin the Darkbinder awaits to oversee their progress in commanding greater fiends.

sections.title: A Message from the Underground
sections.body: Demonology stays hidden across Alliance lands. In Ironforge, Lago Blackwrench quietly watches wandering practitioners for the brotherhood in Stormwind. When a warlock masters their first minions, word travels quickly. Lago sends word to leave the snowy mountains of Khaz Modan and report south without delay.

sections.title: Return to the Slaughtered Lamb
sections.body: Beneath The Slaughtered Lamb in Stormwind's Mage Quarter, Gakin the Darkbinder coordinates the city's warlocks. He sees every capable student as a valuable but hazardous investment. His summons marks the threshold of true demonic binding. Now begin the trials to subjugate a succubus from the Twisting Nether.

faq.answer: Lago Blackwrench, a warlock trainer in Ironforge, delivers the summons on behalf of Gakin the Darkbinder, who leads demonology instruction in Stormwind.

faq.q: Where do I find Gakin the Darkbinder?
faq.answer: Gakin the Darkbinder lives in the dark, winding catacombs beneath The Slaughtered Lamb, a tavern in Stormwind's Mage Quarter.
You have advanced far enough in your craft to undertake the rituals that summon and subjugate a succubus, adding to your demonic arsenal.

faq.q: What happens after I speak to Gakin?
faq.answer: After you speak to Gakin, he sends you on Devourer of Souls. You will travel into dangerous lands to gather the ritual components needed to conjure and bind a succubus.

faq.q: Why is a warlock in Ironforge taking orders from Stormwind?
faq.answer: Alliance warlocks keep a discreet network out of necessity. Ironforge and Stormwind practitioners stay in contact and direct promising apprentices to Gakin, who has specialized ritual equipment and lore beneath The Slaughtered Lamb.

faq.q: Can I ignore this summons if I want to stay in Khaz Modan?
aliases: do i need to go to stormwind
faq.answer: You can delay your visit to Stormwind, but learning to summon a succubus requires completing Gakin's trial. The journey is essential for any aspiring warlock.

angles.text: As a warlock, you are sent from Ironforge back to Stormwind to begin the multi-part ritual that binds your succubus minion.
As an Alliance member, you see how the covert warlock network keeps in touch across its capitals while demonology stays hidden from civilian eyes.
As a gnome warlock training under Lago Blackwrench in Ironforge, you are sent to Stormwind's underground network for deeper demonic teachings.
